anomalies.description: A sudden ground-level explosion occurs at approximately t=3.0s, producing a rapidly expanding dark smoke plume that grows in volume and height through t=7.5s. The event originates from a point on the paved surface with no visible vehicle or structure involved, consistent with a buried or surface explosive device detonating.

A large, sustained plume of dense black smoke erupts from the ground in an open paved area, expanding rapidly and rising vertically, consistent with a high-yield explosion (e.g., IED or vehicle-borne device). The smoke volume increases significantly over time, obscuring the origin point by frame f15.

A large, rapidly expanding plume of dense black smoke erupts from ground level in an open paved area, consistent with a high-yield explosion (e.g., vehicle-borne IED or munition detonation). The smoke cloud grows continuously, obscuring the background and filling the frame by t=15.5s.

A close-up, blurry image at 50.5s shows a person's face (likely a child) with visible distress and possible injury (swelling or bruising around eye), partially obscured by what appears to be a helmet or restraint; subsequent frames (51.0–51.5s) remain dark and indistinct but suggest continued proximity and instability, consistent with an ongoing abusive act against a helpless individual.; A person appears to be lying on the ground or restrained while another individual is positioned over them in a manner suggesting physical assault; visible facial distress and proximity indicate a helpless victim being attacked.
Two individuals engaged in close physical struggle; one appears to be on the ground while the other is positioned over them with visible limb contact and motion consistent with grappling or striking.

A person lying on the ground appears restrained or incapacitated while another individual looms over them; facial expression in f10 suggests distress or helplessness, consistent with abuse of a vulnerable individual.
